thread:
Jane (salesdev): Hey team, small POC ask from NY FinServ — they want a single artifact matrix we can hand to procurement + a short pen-test letter they can attach to their vendor review. Can we run a quick checklist?

Ankur (solutions): Sure — do we know if they need on-prem image artifacts or just hosted SOC 2/ISO PDFs + pen-test attestation?

Jane (salesdev): They said 'private deployment preferred' but will accept Hosted if we can show KMS separation and network diagrams. Also asked about staging creds for a short smoke test (no production data).

Liz (security): For pen-test letter, we can provide our standard attestation template + last external scan summary. If they insist on an on-prem package, we need to confirm licensing and support SLAs.

Marco (ops): For staging creds, we prefer presigned uploads for evidence transfer. If they need SFTP, we can provision a temporary bucket with a jump-host — that adds ~2 business days.

Jane (salesdev): Can you assemble an "artifact matrix" mapping items to files + responsible team? Customer wants artifacts grouped under: SOC 2 cert (scope), ISO excerpt, pen-test letter, external vuln scan, network diagram, KMS key separation notes, on-prem image SHA256 (if applicable), and staging access instructions.

Ankur (solutions): I'll draft the matrix. Quick question: is there an existing redwood-presigned process snippet we can include?

Marco (ops): Yep, quick presigned example below for S3 upload we can paste in the matrix:

```
# presigned PUT example (python boto3)
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket': 'redwood-evidence', 'Key': 'acme-poc/evidence.zip'}, ExpiresIn=3600)
print(url)
```

Marco (ops): Note: we never include keys in the docs. We send ephemeral creds via 1Password shared vault or a presigned URL.

Liz (security): Also include: bullet on what we redact (PII, PHI) before handing artifacts, and an intake confirmation step for the POC. For SOC 2 scope, we should explicitly call out that hosted API is covered under our Type II scope; Private infra requires separate attestation language.

Jane (salesdev): Helpful. Customer asked about SLA impact if we add dedicated capacity for the POC — any quick guidance I can give them in the matrix (like ETA/pricing rough)?

Ankur (solutions): Put a placeholder: "Dedicated capacity — estimated 3-5 business days to provision; pricing depends on GPU class and commit. Contact salesops for quote." I can add a link to the Dedicated pricing doc.

Marco (ops): For on-prem images, we can provide checksum + install guide. NOTE: we require a signed MSA + support addendum before delivering images. Add that as a gating artifact.

Liz (security): I'll prepare a short pen-test attestation letter. Template will say: scope (external surface), date of last test, summary of findings (none/low/medium), remediation window.

Jane (salesdev): Perfect. Can we also include a quick checklist for the customer security questionnaire? e.g., where to find answers for: data residency, key management, audit logs, user access reviews. Keeps legal happy.

Ankur (solutions): I'll add a 1-page "Questionnaire cheat-sheet" mapping common questionnaire items to our artifacts.

audit-bot: evidence-bundle-uploaded: /dumps/acme-poc/evidence-stub-2026-03-21.zip

Marco (ops): Uploaded stub contains: SOC2-excerpt.pdf, iso27001-snapshot.pdf, external-scan-summary.json (redacted), network-diagram-v1.pdf. We'll swap the stub with the final bundle once sec signs the letter.

Liz (security): ETA for final letter + review: 24-36 hours. After that I can sign and Marco can finalize the bundle.

Jane (salesdev): Great — I will send this matrix + provisional SLA note to the customer today and flag the bundle will be updated in 48 hours. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ankur (solutions): Adding action items: 1) Ankur — draft matrix + questionnaire cheat-sheet. 2) Liz — pen-test attestation & redaction rules. 3) Marco — presigned snippet + final bundle when Liz signs. 4) Jane — send to customer and track legal/msa gating.

Jane (salesdev): I'll follow up in this thread with the draft document link so we can iterate. Thanks!
